Another famous basilica also named after Saint Peter is **St. Peter's Basilica** (the Basilica di San Pietro), which is located within the **Vatican City**.

Vatican City became its own sovereign country on **February 11, 1929**, when the Lateran Treaty was signed between the Kingdom of Italy and the Holy See. This treaty established Vatican City as an independent state under the sovereignty of the Pope, resolving the "Roman Question" that had existed since 1870.
